issues.explanation: The section explicitly claims to present Figure 1 'همان‌گونه که چاپ شده' (as printed), yet omits «مدل» from two box labels in the unlabelled middle row. Evidence F23681-شکل ۱ transcribes those boxes as «بازآموزی مدل با داده‌های افزوده» and «بازآموزی مدل برای استفاده سفارشی»; the section renders them without «مدل». (Note: evidence item S23681-012 also omits «مدل» in its summary, but the authoritative figure transcription F23681-شکل ۱ includes it, and a verbatim-fidelity claim must match the figure source.)
